procedure: Confirm the locked source-v7 authority image identity and source label without pulling/building.
Inside the isolated tmpfs, save a preexisting file through write_bounded and a baseline row through connect_sqlite.
Allocate tmpfs to ENOSPC and retain at most 128 KiB free; attempt a 900 KiB write_bounded document and require no successful target, unchanged baseline bytes, and no leaked temporary.
Restore tmpfs free space and verify a new bounded write and readback succeed.

Refill tmpfs to ENOSPC; attempt a 2 MiB SQLite insert using the locked sqlite_limits connection; require SQLITE_FULL, rollback, baseline row preservation, then free space, integrity_check, and a recovery insert/readback.
Record all output and remove only the container with this run UUID and matching label.
Preallocate a 2 MiB FailureSink file on the dedicated tmpfs and verify the API reports physical allocation before pressure is applied.

Create real tmpfs ENOSPC while retaining at most 128 KiB free; record a fixed synthetic incomplete envelope containing an original receipt marker and an unsettled-reservation marker. Require record/fsync/internal readback to succeed.

While pressure remains, start a fresh Python process and use read_existing to verify the complete envelope; release pressure and verify read_existing again. Keep durable_after_enospc and bound_verified false; this synthetic envelope is not application reservation integration.
Inside the diagnostic, also reject a small deeply nested malformed JSON payload with fixed SINK_READBACK_FAILED and reject a FIFO before blocking open with PATH_REJECTED.
scope_limit: Local FailureSink primitive diagnostic on locked source-v7 image with one readonly module overlay.
